challenge.en: Preventing unbounded token spend while preserving complete citation provenance.
challenge.zh-TW: 在完整保留引證來源的前提下，防止多 Agent 研究綜述 Token 超支。

solution.en: TALK 1.8 budget gate blocks over-budget plans (6.0 > 5.0) and reroutes to T5 compact (4.6).
solution.zh-TW: TALK 1.8 預算閘門熔斷超標方案（6.0 > 5.0），自主重導向至 T5 精簡綜述（4.6）。

boundary.en: 6.0 → 4.6 is calculated TALK budget; not human reading time or wall-clock speedup.
boundary.zh-TW: 邊界界定：6.0 → 4.6 為計算型 TALK 預算，非真人閱讀時間或秒數加速。

strictInvariant.en: Calculated TALK budget must not exceed 5.0 ceiling; all citations must retain mathematical provenance to source papers.
strictInvariant.zh-TW: 計算型 TALK 預算嚴格不可超越 5.0 上限；所有綜述引證必須保留至原論文之數學推論出處。

en: Blind LLM hallucinated summarization without provenance verification
zh-TW: 無邊界的網頁爬蟲與遞迴檢索
無引證出處校驗的盲目 LLM 幻覺摘要

failureConditions.en: When user query complexity triggers a plan estimation > 5.0 TALK, execution is blocked at the gate and rerouted to T5 compact mode (4.6) with zero token leakage.
failureConditions.zh-TW: 當查詢複雜度觸發預估花費 > 5.0 TALK 時，閘門即時中斷執行並重導向至 T5 精簡模式（4.6），達到零 Token 洩漏。

challenger.en: Why build a custom TALK budget gate rather than simply letting an LLM agent summarize with max_tokens set in the API call?
challenger.zh-TW: 為什麼要自訂 TALK 預算閘門，而不是單純在 API 呼叫中設定 max_tokens 讓 LLM 自己總結？

defense.en: API max_tokens is a blunt truncation mechanism—it cuts output mid-sentence and doesn't prevent wasteful multi-agent recursive exploration upstream. The TALK gate evaluates the execution graph prior to dispatch, enforcing cognitive budgeting and deliberate synthesis routing before billing occurs.
defense.zh-TW: API 的 max_tokens 只是生硬的截斷機制——它會在句子中途切斷，且完全無法防止上游多 Agent 遞迴搜尋的 Token 浪費。TALK 閘門在派發前即評估執行圖預算，在計費產生前強制執行認知預算控管與精簡重導向。

challenger.en: How do you prove that 6.0 → 4.6 isn't just an arbitrary number?
challenger.zh-TW: 如何證明 6.0 → 4.6 不只是隨意捏造的數字？

defense.en: TALK 1.8 is an explicit formal cost model based on input token AST density and reasoning step weights, backed by verifiable JSON-LD receipts in the walkthrough artifact, explicitly scoped as calculated budget rather than wall-clock seconds.
defense.zh-TW: TALK 1.8 是基於輸入 Token AST 密度與推理步權重的形式化成本模型，在歷史流程展示中具備 JSON-LD 數位收據，並在邊界中嚴格界定為計算預算而非真人碼錶時間。

staff.en: Formal TALK contract & circuit-breaker preventing multi-agent combinatorial explosion
staff.zh-TW: 形式化 TALK 契約與熔斷器，根絕多 Agent 組合爆炸

em.en: Deterministic budget capping (6.0 → 4.6) and zero-drift technical briefing synthesis
em.zh-TW: 確定性預算收斂（6.0 → 4.6），技術綜述品質零漂移

recruiter.zh-TW: Agent 系統 · 認知邊界 · 形式化預算契約 · 完整引證追溯
